entries.german: Eberhard und Ulrich von Rosenberg vereinigen sich, die Schäferei, die bisher Eberhard allein hatte, gemeinsam zu haben.
entries.english: Eberhard and Ulrich von Rosenberg unite to have the sheep farm, which Eberhard alone had previously alone.
facts: Eberhard von Rosenberg previously held the Schäferei alone
